title: Moon Dust document: spherical objects recovered in New Zealand farmland

tellings.quote: One document describes the recovery of spherical objects in New Zealand farmland.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, cites a declassified document from Moon Dust, a US government effort to recover objects that fell from the sky. He says it describes spherical objects being recovered from farmland in New Zealand, which he offers as evidence that the government ran a quiet worldwide crash retrieval effort.
